source.snippet: I'm setting up a second-generation managed package using two separate, newly created Salesforce Developer Edition organizations: A Dev Hub organization with Dev Hub and second-generation managed packaging enabled. A namespace organization where the permanent namespace was successfully registered. When I go to Setup → Namespace Registries → Link Namespace in the Dev Hub, the Salesforce-generated authorization window immediately returns: error=invalid_request&error_description=missing%20required%20[PKCE parameter].

problem_statement: Salesforce ISVs building second-generation managed packages (2GP) repeatedly hit blocking platform bugs — PKCE errors during namespace linking and packages not appearing in the Partner Security Portal — that stall AppExchange submission and delay revenue.
target_segment: Independent software vendors (ISVs) and Salesforce development agencies building managed packages for the AppExchange marketplace.
notes: Two separate Stack Exchange posts from different users in the same week (namespace PKCE error + package missing from security portal) indicate a recurring, systemic friction point. ISVs are paying Salesforce partners — revenue is gated behind security review completion. A guided setup service, diagnostic tool, or consultancy that unblocks 2GP onboarding has clear willingness-to-pay: AppExchange listings generate significant recurring revenue so even a $500-2000 unblocking service has obvious ROI. Buyer intent is strong.
